description: A yellow tabletop is in front with a light blue cleaning cloth on it and a small spray bottle standing near the right side, against a pale fabric backdrop. The left hand presses the left-hand object (the cloth) to the surface and wipes in short strokes from left to right and back toward the center, while the right hand holds the right-hand object (the spray bottle) hovering near the surface without spraying, then shifts slightly closer as the wiping continues.
